mo_ta_cong_viec:
We are looking for a proactive and hands-on leader to drive project execution, lead development teams, coordinate with Japanese clients, and ensure successful delivery in terms of quality, schedule, and cost.
 
Reporting
Provide accurate and timely reporting on project progress, quality status, risks, issues, and team productivity and propose corrective actions to support Project Manager decision-making.
Team Management
Directly manage and coordinate a team of approximately 5–6 members, including task assignment, daily follow-up, progress monitoring, issue identification, and daily execution control.
Translate project plans, priorities, and management decisions into actionable tasks and ensure effective execution by team members.
Planning
Support project planning activities, including effort estimation, work breakdown structure (WBS) creation, task decomposition, and detailed work planning.
Quality Management
Take responsibility for the quality and timely delivery of outputs produced by assigned team members through reviews, defect identification, corrective guidance, and verification of improvement results.
Lead testing activities, including test planning, test design reviews, defect analysis, and quality assurance throughout the development lifecycle.
Issue Management
Identify project risks, quality issues, schedule deviations, and resource concerns, and report them proactively with proposed mitigation actions.
Identify root causes of defects and project issues, recommend preventive actions, and drive continuous quality improvement.
Customer Relationship & Communication
Manage requirement, design, and testing-related inquiries with customers, ensuring timely clarification, tracking, and resolution of project questions and issues.
Communicate directly with Japanese customers and stakeholders in project meetings, progress reviews, issue discussions, and technical discussions in Japanese.
Coaching
Coach and mentor team members, fostering technical growth and continuous improvement.
Continuous improvement activities
Contribute to process improvement initiatives and promote best practices in software development and project execution.
Perform other tasks as assigned by Management.
